architecture_decisions: {Architecture Decision: Use Vercel AI Gateway for deterministic production transport}
work_items: {Work Item: Correct failed P2-V0.18.9 production transport assumption}
validations: {Validation: Validate that the Gateway transport selection is deterministic and does not rely on process-environment `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN`}

AC-01: validate protected requirement — For a production request with a valid `x-vercel-oidc-token` and no explicit DSPY override, the validated request credential is passed into DSPy construction; `build_lm("openai/gpt-5.6-terra", ...)` preserves that canonical model string and passes `api_base="https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1"` plus the opaque request token as LM authentication.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Automatic production model transport must not read or rely on process-environment `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN`. A production request missing valid request-scoped OIDC and lacking an explicit DSPY override fails closed instead of silently selecting direct OpenAI or another credential source.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — `ModelRouter.MODEL_ORDER` remains exactly `openai/gpt-5.6-luna`, `openai/gpt-5.6-terra`, `openai/gpt-5.6-sol`; Gateway transport selection does not rewrite those externally recorded identities.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — If `DSPY_API_BASE` or `DSPY_API_KEY` is explicitly configured, `build_lm` uses the explicit values and does not substitute the Vercel Gateway endpoint, even when request-scoped OIDC or Gateway API keys are also available.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — After any explicit DSPY override, an explicitly admitted request-scoped production OIDC credential wins. For non-production or controlled non-request construction without such a credential, server-owned Gateway keys resolve deterministically as `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` then `VERCEL_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`. Process-environment `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN` is excluded from automatic resolution.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Outside production, when no explicit DSPY override, Gateway API key or admitted request credential exists, Parallax preserves existing direct-provider/local development behavior and does not fabricate credentials or provider authority.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Focused tests prove Gateway keys/OIDC tokens are passed only into the LM constructor/provider boundary and never appear in public/canonical model identity, routing traces, persisted evidence, logger messages, exception text or source-controlled examples.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — The credential-free local DSPy/Ollama path using explicit `DSPY_API_BASE` continues to execute without Gateway substitution, and authentic SpecCritic + SpecCompiler development evidence remains possible.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — The automatic hosted Gateway path no longer depends on rewriting canonical models to `vercel_ai_gateway/...`; deterministic tests reject reintroduction of the namespace-only OIDC assumption.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Conversation scope/reason, Work Specification drafting, and protected implementation generation use one bounded Gateway transport contract derived from the validated request-scoped production identity; none may silently fall back to a different provider path in production.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — `RoutingFailureKind`, sanitized `AttemptRecord`, Work Specification recovery semantics, authentication, Project/repository binding, Work Specification approval, Engineering Run state, source lineage, tools, provider delivery, protected evaluation, REVIEW/HUMAN_REQUIRED and deployment authority remain unchanged and existing regressions stay green.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — The authentic compiled DSPy plan passes `--require-dspy`; exact worker-head Workstream Spec Validation, Bounded Autonomy and P2 CI pass; merge uses expected-head protection; production API promotion is bound to an exact release identity; post-cutover authenticated Capture Spec succeeds, `/health` and `/ready` are HTTP 200, and exact-deployment runtime logs show no model-capacity failure for that smoke before `CURRENT-STATE.md` is reconciled and #284 is closed.
risks: {Risk: Risk of failure to preserve canonical Parallax model identities and Luna -> Terra -> Sol order}
